traitDetails.name: Draconic Ancestry
traitDetails.summary: Choose a draconic ancestor; it sets your Breath Weapon damage type and resistance.

traitDetails.name: Breath Weapon
traitDetails.summary: Exhale destructive energy in a cone or line; uses equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest.

traitDetails.name: Damage Resistance
traitDetails.summary: You have Resistance to the damage type associated with your Draconic Ancestry.

traitDetails.name: Darkvision
traitDetails.summary: You can see in Dim Light within 60 feet as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as Dim Light.

traitDetails.name: Draconic Flight
traitDetails.summary: As a Bonus Action, sprout spectral wings and fly for 10 minutes.

traitDetails.name: Darkvision
traitDetails.summary: You can see in Dim Light within 120 feet as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as Dim Light.

traitDetails.name: Dwarven Resilience
traitDetails.summary: You have Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saves against the Poisoned condition.

traitDetails.name: Dwarven Toughness
traitDetails.summary: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

traitDetails.name: Stonecunning
traitDetails.summary: As a Bonus Action, you gain Tremorsense 60 feet for 10 minutes; uses equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest.

traitDetails.name: Darkvision
traitDetails.summary: You can see in Dim Light within 60 feet as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as Dim Light.

traitDetails.name: Elven Lineage
traitDetails.summary: Choose a lineage (for example Drow, High Elf, or Wood Elf) that grants spells and other benefits as you level.

traitDetails.name: Fey Ancestry
traitDetails.summary: You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traitDetails.name: Keen Senses
traitDetails.summary: You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill.

traitDetails.name: Trance
traitDetails.summary: You don't need to sleep; a 4-hour trance gives you the same benefit as a long rest.

traitDetails.name: Darkvision
traitDetails.summary: You can see in Dim Light within 60 feet as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as Dim Light.

traitDetails.name: Gnomish Cunning
traitDetails.summary: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traitDetails.name: Gnomish Lineage
traitDetails.summary: Choose Forest or Rock Gnome lineage for cantrips and further magic as you level.

traitDetails.name: Giant Ancestry
traitDetails.summary: Choose a giant ancestry that grants a supernatural boon you can use a few times per long rest.

traitDetails.name: Large Form
traitDetails.summary: As a Bonus Action, become Large for 10 minutes (once per long rest), with Advantage on Strength checks and +10 feet speed.

traitDetails.name: Powerful Build
traitDetails.summary: You count as one size larger when determining carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traitDetails.name: Brave
traitDetails.summary: You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

traitDetails.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traitDetails.summary: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than yours.

traitDetails.name: Luck
traitDetails.summary: When you roll a 1 on a d20 Test, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

traitDetails.name: Naturally Stealthy
traitDetails.summary: You can take the Hide action even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

traitDetails.name: Resourceful
traitDetails.summary: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a long rest.

traitDetails.name: Skillful
traitDetails.summary: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice. Select it on the Training step.

traitDetails.name: Versatile
traitDetails.summary: You gain an Origin feat of your choice. Select it on the Training step.

traitDetails.name: Adrenaline Rush
traitDetails.summary: As a Bonus Action, Dash and gain temporary Hit Points; uses equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest.

traitDetails.name: Darkvision
traitDetails.summary: You can see in Dim Light within 120 feet as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as Dim Light.

traitDetails.name: Relentless Endurance
traitDetails.summary: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead (once per long rest).

traitDetails.name: Darkvision
traitDetails.summary: You can see in Dim Light within 60 feet as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as Dim Light.

traitDetails.name: Fiendish Legacy
traitDetails.summary: Choose an infernal legacy that grants Resistance and spells as you gain levels.

traitDetails.name: Otherworldly Presence
traitDetails.summary: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip, using Charisma as your spellcasting ability for it.
